title: COBIT 2019 Foundation – ISACA
overview: The COBIT 2019 Foundation course provides a comprehensive introduction to the COBIT 2019 framework for managing and governing enterprise IT. This course covers the core principles, concepts, and practices of COBIT 2019, offering participants foundational knowledge in IT governance and management. It prepares individuals for the COBIT 2019 Foundation exam and equips them with the skills necessary to apply COBIT principles in their organizations.
audience: IT professionals involved in IT governance and management.
Risk management professionals and business leaders.
Individuals seeking the COBIT 2019 Foundation certification.
methodology: Lectures and Presentations: In-depth explanation of COBIT 2019 principles and practices.
Hands-On Labs: Practical exercises to apply COBIT concepts.
Case Studies: Analysis of real-world scenarios using COBIT 2019.
Group Discussions: Interactive sessions to explore governance challenges and solutions.
Quizzes and Practice Exams: Assessments to evaluate understanding and readiness for the certification exam.
competencies: Application of COBIT in various IT environments
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: To provide a foundational understanding of the COBIT 2019 framework and its components.
To develop skills for applying COBIT principles in IT governance and management.
To prepare participants for the COBIT 2019 Foundation certification exam.
To equip participants with techniques for improving IT governance and management practices.
